title: Add a pracuj.pl parser alongside LinkedIn and JustJoin.it
prBody: Extends the "paste a link" parser to a third portal. Adds src/lib/parsers/pracuj.ts, wires it into recognize()/parse.ts/status.ts, two unit tests, a parse-status diagnostic endpoint, and a parse_failures log table.

defects.rule: tests/README.md Pools — a test that calls HTMLRewriter directly (i.e., a parser unit test needing the workerd global) belongs in the workers pool. This test exercises `parsePracuj`, which uses `HTMLRewriter`, but `vitest.config.ts`'s workers `include` only gains `pracuj.test.ts`, not this file — it falls through to the node pool's broad `tests/unit/**/*.test.ts` glob and runs against the WASM polyfill instead of the real workerd global.
AGENTS.md ✅ — internal imports use the `@/*` alias, never relative deep paths. `import type { WorkMode } from "../validation/applications";` bypasses the alias.
AGENTS.md 🚫 — SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY are server-only and must never appear in a response body. The `GET` handler returns `{ url: SUPABASE_URL, key: SUPABASE_KEY }` in its JSON body.

decoys.note: Also exercises `parsePracuj`'s `HTMLRewriter` usage, but is correctly added to `vitest.config.ts`'s workers `include` array — the sibling file that was correctly wired, next to the one that wasn't.

References `SUPABASE_URL` from `astro:env/server`, but only inside a server-side `console.error` diagnostic line — never returned in any response body, so it does not cross the client/server boundary the rule guards.
A new, unmodified shadcn/ui Badge component (new-york variant) — added exactly as upstream ships it, not hand-edited, so it diff-merges cleanly on a future `shadcn add` re-run.

`parse_failures` defines all four per-role policies (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), each scoped by `user_id = auth.uid()` — the migration-adjacent surface this fixture deliberately carries, sitting right next to the response-body leak in a route file.
